scripts.start:dev: bun run dev:backend & bun run dev:frontend & wait
scripts.build: bun run build:backend && bun run build:frontend
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd backend lint && bun run --cwd frontend lint
scripts.test: bun run --cwd backend test && bun run --cwd frontend test
scripts.ponytail:claude: claude plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail && claude plugin install ponytail@ponytail
scripts.ponytail:codex: codex plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail && codex plugin add ponytail@ponytail
